title: Ultimate Earth & Dungeons Variants
description: Almost all mobs from Minecraft Dungeons and Earth, blinking mobs and additional vanilla-feeling variants.
body:
# More Variety for Your Minecraft World
## Ever wanted your Minecraft world to feel as full of life as its spin-offs do?
This pack incorporates almost all mobs from Minecraft Earth and Dungeons into the base game through remodels and retextures without replacing existing mobs. As well as some custom vanilla-feeling textures from talented pack creators.

**This pack contains new mobs from the following:**
- Minecraft Dungeons
- Minecraft Earth
- Minecraft Legends (WIP)
- Mob/Biome Votes

This project started out as a pack for personal use, however after the Tiny Takeover update I wanted to share my own work on the baby mobs. But to do that I figured I may as well include everything else seen as my pack was already somewhat finished.

Each mob has a different rarity depending on where it spawns, and most are exclusive to biomes that feel canon, promoting exploration and using mobs for detailed world building. However every retexture and model has name tag dependencies attached to them too, allowing you to rename a mob to your desired retexture and bring it with you anywhere in your world!

Mobs now blink! Using the ETF mod, mobs will randomly blink, and those that sleep will close their eyes while doing so. This excludes undead mobs and creatures like creepers, axolotls and fish.


## REQUIRES
**Entity Model Features + Entity Texture Features  or  Optifine**
